title: 第15章 圣城繁华第16章 灵农坊新家
slug: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
lines: 飞舟上逐渐变得安静起来，风洛依之前讲的很全面，都在消化。
随着时间流逝，夜幕降临，已经不知飞出了多少万里。
没有人说要吃饭。
出发前都早有准备，服用辟谷丹，不止不需要吃，还不需要拉。
慢慢地，五人胆子都大了，敢站起来随意行走。
双胞胎的老大风雷看起来比较成熟，肩宽背厚，铁塔一样的汉子，带着一股豪迈之气朝沈云走来。
“我们都为真传做事，到了圣城，还需相互照顾。”
拉着风白萱聊后，他过来还找沈云聊了几句。
舟上五人，看似沈云地位最低，未来不会是圣宗弟子，但确实是名义上唯一一个为风洛依做事的人。
“雷少爷不嫌弃，我自然愿意。”
沈云笑着点头，去了圣城两眼一抹黑，有人谈交情他自是乐意。
风雷也自知是走后门入圣宗，并没有风白萱那般骄傲，与沈云约定到了圣城后互相扶持照顾。
第一次交流，并未深谈，约定好便分开了。
风白萱跟着风洛依在船舱前，双胞胎在船首坐定。
沈云则带着婉儿来到飞舟后边，看着下方飞掠过去的蛮荒风景，很惬意。
这白骨飞舟不看中间那骷髅头，还不错。
夜逐渐深，苏婉儿给沈云揉着腰背，这种境地下，依旧不忘福报点。
“轻一点。”
按摩一会儿，他就起身打起了养生拳，获得了最后五点。
入阶之后，沈云发现习练养生拳的时候调动气血，对于身体有滋养效果。
不伤身。
每日都打上半时辰到一个时辰。
飞舟上的一切都在风洛依的感应下，看沈云这个年纪此时不忘努力，暗自点了点头。
只是年纪太大，身子骨需要保养，练一会就不行了。
不过能激发气血通行阵法，看守灵田足矣。
夜里，沈云他们在飞舟一角陷入梦乡。
白骨飞舟外有屏障，内部精气流转充沛，白骨若暖玉，丝毫不觉寒冷。
第二日，飞舟外依旧是千篇一律的景色。
沈云一直在看着，他注意到城池相聚越来越密集，这个城池到另一个城池的时间越来越短。
蛮荒大山丛林，原始景象依旧是主色调，人类占据不过巴掌大的地方。
沈云居高临下看到过小山般高大的白玉巨象，火山口沐浴在岩浆中的赤色蛟龙，一跃千米高的庞大魔猿。
看到过最多的，还是被追杀的猎荒者们。
有蛮兽与人族的战争，更不缺修士与修士的大战。
蛮荒不平静，风洛依驾驭白骨舟一路疾驰，未曾停歇。
其间有不少异兽试图追逐白骨飞舟，基本都被远远甩在后面。
最危险的一次是一只金翅鹏鸟追逐飞舟而来，速度很快，宛若金色闪电。
content_en:
The flying boat gradually became quiet, and Feng Luoyi was digesting what he had said before.
As time goes by, night falls, and I don’t know how many thousands of miles I have flown.
No one said anything about eating.
I was prepared before setting off. Taking Bigu Dan, not only did I not need to eat, but I also didn’t need to have diarrhea.
Slowly, the five of them became bolder and dared to stand up and walk around freely.
The eldest of the twins, Fenglei, looked more mature, with broad shoulders and a thick back. He was like an iron tower and walked towards Chen Yun with a heroic spirit.
"We all work for the True Inheritance, and when we get to the Holy City, we need to take care of each other."
After chatting with Feng Baixuan, he came over and chatted with Shen Yun for a few words.
Among the five people on the boat, Shen Yun seemed to have the lowest status and would not be a disciple of the Holy Sect in the future, but he was indeed the only one who nominally worked for Feng Luoyi.
"Master Lei doesn't mind it, so of course I am willing."
Chen Yun smiled and nodded. His eyes darkened when he went to the Holy City. He would be happy to have someone to talk to.
Feng Lei also knew that he had entered the Holy Sect through the back door, and was not as proud as Feng Baixuan. He and Shen Yun agreed to support and take care of each other after arriving in the Holy City.
The first communication was not in depth, and they separated after making an agreement.
Feng Baixuan followed Feng Luoyi in front of the cabin, and the twins sat down at the bow.
Chen Yun took Wan'er to the back of the flying boat and felt very comfortable looking at the wild scenery flying past below.
This bone flying boat is not bad except for the skull in the middle.
As the night progressed, Su Waner rubbed Chen Yun's back. In this situation, she still did not forget the blessings.
"Be gentle."
After massaging for a while, he got up and started practicing health-preserving boxing, gaining the last five points.
After entering the level, Shen Yun discovered that practicing health-preserving boxing can mobilize qi and blood, which has a nourishing effect on the body.
No harm to the body.
I play for half an hour to an hour every day.
Everything on the flying boat was under the influence of Feng Luoyi. Seeing that Shen Yun did not forget to work hard at this age, he nodded secretly.
It's just that I'm too old and my body and bones need maintenance, and it won't be enough after practicing for a while.
However, the formation that can stimulate the flow of Qi and blood is enough to guard the spiritual field.
At night, Shen Yun and the others fell asleep in a corner of the flying boat.
There is a barrier outside the white bone flying boat, and the energy inside is flowing abundantly. The white bones are like warm jade, and it does not feel cold at all.
On the second day, the scenery outside the flying boat was still the same.
Shen Yun had been watching, and he noticed that the cities were getting denser and denser, and the time from one city to another was getting shorter and shorter.
The primitive scenery of the wild mountains and jungles is still the main color, and humans cannot occupy a place as big as a palm.
From a high position, Shen Yun saw a giant white jade elephant as tall as a hill, a red dragon bathing in magma at the crater of a volcano, and a huge demonic ape that leaped a thousand meters high.
The ones I have seen the most are the hunters who are being hunted.
There are wars between beasts and humans, not to mention battles between monks and monks.
The wilderness was not peaceful, and Feng Luoyi drove the bone boat and galloped all the way without stopping.
During this period, many strange beasts tried to chase the Bone Flying Boat, but most of them were left far behind.
The most dangerous time was when a golden-winged roc chased the flying boat at a very fast speed, like golden lightning.
